Folks — did a quick modeling pass. A few operational points:
1) 35% for 90 days has a material short-term margin impact but is manageable for pilots if we cap the total eligible MRR (suggest cap $60k gross ARR across all Fluxly-referred conversions).
2) Lead registration: HubSpot submissions + mutual confirmation email chain will be required to lock a registration; recommend stamping with both partner and Redwood HubSpot contact IDs.
3) Clawback: Revenue systems prefer a 90-day clawback for simplicity. If we do 30-day for this pilot, we need an explicit addendum and finance sign-off.

Operational ask: Camila/Marissa — can you draft a one-off addendum that: (a) specifies 35% for first 90 days up to $60k ARR cap, (b) 6-month registration protection with HubSpot submission proof, (c) 30-day clawback for cancellations within 60 days of conversion, and (d) explicit data capture fields we can use for attribution?
